svg.aria-label: In Drydock: Dead Keys, under construction. A typing game, back from the dead. In 2000, almost half of US high school grads took a typing class. By 2019 it was 2.5%. Dead Keys rebuilds the 1980s typing games I grew up on as a trainer that notices which keys you miss and drills them. It picks up where Office Keys left off.
